name: real-app-chat-1000
_comment: Chat capacity without media on FrameConsole (CHAT-01, --host <sender IP>): up to 1000 chat sockets, 2% of them send 6 messages/min; connected, joined and refused counts come from the client side and from /api/stats chat {clients, joined, refused} and http {threads, refused}. The current app source allows 2000 chat clients / 2600 HTTP threads (c54c07d had 300 / 400); refusals above the build's limits are the measurement and end the run via success-below-min. Hold 45 s per stage (fast iteration).
